The Journal is a menu item in The Long Dark. It can be accessed by the default hotkey "J" or from the book icon at the top of the game menu.
The Journal contains eight menus: Log, Skills, Collections, Rock Caches, General Notes, Stats, Trader, and Photo Album.
The Log menu provides a day by day overview of each day played on the current sandbox. There are two submenu tabs for this section.
1. Locations discovered - Or more accurately, locations visited, as any visited locations that have previously been discovered will also be listed here.
2. World explored - Given as a percentage. It is unclear exactly how this is calculated within the game.
4. Condition Range - Displays the highest% Condition of the day as well as the lowest% Condition.
6. Injuries sustained - Displayed as an integer, without any details about how the injuries were sustained.

Contains a single "notepad" where players can jot down notes. While this is marginally useful to remember storage cache locations or directions, it is currently not possible to make more than one "thread" or organize notes in any way other than manual editing, thereby limiting it's utility compared to a simple in-game word processor.

The [Skills](./Skills.md) submenu provides details about current skill levels (primary skills only), perks of those levels, and progress to the next skill level within the current sandbox. Note that this menu scrolls down to reveal additional skills, depending on display settings.

Note that secondary skills (cleaning, sharpening, and repair) are not listed in this menu and can only be tracked indirectly when attempting to perform an action related to that skill within the game menu.
The Collections menu provides information about 8 [Collectibles](./Collectibles.md) that are available within the game, including:
1. ![Notes icon](../assets/Notes_icon.png) [Notes](./Notes.md) - There are a total of 25 "notes left behind" that can be tracked and reread using this submenu.

2. ![Transmitters icon](../assets/Transmitters_icon.png) [Transmitters](./Transmitters.md) - Opens up a unique screen that shows all discovered and repaired Transmitters as well as their radio coverage on the island.

3. ![Recipe Cards icon](../assets/Recipe_Cards_icon.png) [Unique Recipes](./Recipe%20Cards.md) - 9 unique Recipe Cards can be acquired across the island and unlock special Cooking Level 5 Recipes for the player.

4. ![Polaroids icon](../assets/Polaroids_icon.png) [Polaroids](./Polaroids.md) - Polaroids are used for mapping - if the player stands at the Vista location shown in the Polaroid after collecting it and surveys the location with [Charcoal](./Charcoal.md), a large area of the [Map](./Map.md) will be revealed. Some regions have 2 Polaroids that can be found.

5. ![Mementos icon](../assets/Mementos_icon.png) [Mementos](./Mementos.md) - Keeps track of all Memento notes and keys that are found. Unique items, such as keys and the [Bolt Cutters](./Bolt%20Cutters.md) found in various [Tales](./Tales.md), are stored here.

6. ![Cairns icon](../assets/Cairns_icon.png) [Cairns](./Cairns.md) - Cairns are tributes to supporters from the Kickstarter campaign, each with a message written by the patron, although in many cases the message is blank (simply stating that "Its story is not yet written…"). There are currently 165 cairns in the game spread across most of the zones.

7. ![Buffer Memories icon](../assets/Buffer_Memories_icon.png) [Buffer Memories](./Buffer%20Memories.md) - Buffer Memories can be found on Computers that become powered during an active Aurora at night. They contain details about life prior to the [Great Collapse](./The%20Collapse.md). They are essential to complete the [Archivist](./Archivist.md) [Challenge](./Challenge.md), but note that this must be completed in the relevant challenge as opposed to normal survival/storyline gameplay.

8. ![Surveyed Locations icon](../assets/Surveyed_Locations_icon.png) [Surveyed Locations](./Surveyed%20Locations.md) - This collectible is a checklist of all mappable locations within the game that count toward the [Faithful Cartographer](./Faithful%20Cartographer.md) achievement. In the current version, an in-game menu with the surveyed locations can be checked. Undiscovered places will be hidden by default, but using the "force reveal" button will make them show, not affecting the achievement.
All collections are entirely optional components of gameplay, but may be linked to various achievements.

The Rock Cache menu contains a list of all ![Rock Cache icon](../assets/Rock_Cache_icon.png) [Rock Caches](./Rock%20Cache.md), subdivided by [Region](./Region.md), that have been created in the current sandbox. Note that there is a limit of five (5) rock caches per region. From this menu, rock cache names and notes can be viewed/edited. The locations of each individual cache can also be viewed from this menu.
The General Notes menu behaves exactly like the Notes section of the Log, being a general notepad where players can jot down notes but as it's own dedicated menu.
The Stats menu contains detailed stats about each playthrough, and compares those stats with the player's all-time high scores, subdivided by difficulty level. The following stats are tracked:

Justy's Hovel is a small cabin located on a plateau on the south-east corner of the map.
The cabin itself has decent loot: it spawns mid tier clothing, food and some tools. It also has a fireplace. A [Cowichan Sweater](./Cowichan%20Sweater.md) might be found on the bed.

The plateau on which the hovel stand has decent resources. It has two Rabbit coves, plenty of firewood, and deer also spawn. A wolf may patrol the area. It can be reached by climbing the rope to the west or by walking up a path to the east.

The cabin is a great place to wait for an [Aurora](./Aurora.md) or [Glimmer Fog](./Glimmer%20Fog.md) to power the [Handheld Shortwave Radio](./Handheld%20Shortwave%20Radio.md) to uncover [Bunker Omega](./Bunker%20Omega.md).

Katie's Secluded Corner is located south of the [Blocked Highway](./Blocked%20Highway.md). It can be located by leaving the road before the Blocked Highway--roughly across the road from the entrance to [Abandoned Mine No. 5](./Abandoned%20Mine%20No.%205.md)--and walking around the boulders on the ice until you see the path leading between the large rocks ahead of you.

While the area is relatively safe, high winds can blow out [campfires](./Campfire.md) and leave the player exposed to the cold, and a prowling wolf may sometimes wander into the sheltered corner. Due to its secluded nature and the path leading there being somewhat hard to find, it can be easy for new players to overlook. A [Memento Hint](./Mementos.md) pointing out this location can be found behind the visor of a truck near the entrance of [Hibernia Processing](./Hibernia%20Processing.md).

Most of the items will be located next to a burnt-out campfire, these include a [Survival Bow](./Survival%20Bow.md), [Research Book](./Research%20Book.md) and a [Deer Carcass](./Deer%20Carcass.md). However, near the cliff face, is where a [Frozen Corpse](./Frozen%20Corpse.md) may reside (possibly the eponymous Katie) along with a possible [Hatchet](./Hatchet.md).
Nearby is a grove of [Rabbits](./Rabbit.md), which can wander down the hill, and attract [wolves](./Wolf.md), so be cautious when traversing.

- The location is named after Katie Sorrell, who designed every region of [Great Bear Island](./Great%20Bear%20Island.md) other than [Coastal Highway](./Coastal%20Highway.md) and [Mystery Lake](./Mystery%20Lake%20%28disambiguation%29.md).
- In 2022, Katie took over from Raphael van Lierop as head game designer, but shortly thereafter, Raphael resumed control again.

**Description:** A large crevice situated in the middle of nowhere, eventually giving way to the road to [Blackrock](./Blackrock.md)
**Connecting Regions:** [Pleasant Valley](./Pleasant%20Valley.md) (via [Keeper's Pass South](./Keeper%27s%20Pass%20South.md) ) [Blackrock](./Blackrock.md)

**Keeper's Pass North** is the 5th Transition Zone [Region](./Region.md) introduced into _[The Long Dark](./The%20Long%20Dark.md)_. It connects to [Keeper's Pass South](./Keeper%27s%20Pass%20South.md) via a cave system (which in turn connects to [Pleasant Valley](./Pleasant%20Valley.md)) and to [Blackrock](./Blackrock.md) to the north.

It consists of winding ravine passage with a rickety rope bridge going over a river that cuts through the region. The region is notable for having no interior shelters or caves, but [Forester's Hermitage](./Forester%27s%20Hermitage.md) does provide a bed and fireplace to stay warm.

The road leading to [Milton](./Milton.md)/Pleasant Valley is damaged, with a landslide having fallen into the river below and the tunnel still blocked. A caved in tunnel that leads to Keeper's Pass South can be found to the east of the map, with a [Rope Climbing](./Rope%20Climbing.md) section nearby leading to the bottom of the river. The bottom of the river contains a shallow cave with an [Emergency Kit](./Emergency%20Kit.md) and a tuffet [Bed](./Bed.md) (the second one found in the region). Falling into the river will result in an immediate game over.
Currently, neither part of Keeper's Pass is featured on the [World Map](./Map.md), but local regional maps can be surveyed.
- [Rabbit](./Rabbit.md) can occasionally be found in the ravine and near Forester's Hermitage.
- A single [Wolf](./Wolf.md) can be found on the road to Blackrock near the transition area.
It is possible for this region to be free of predators after enough days survived pass, a feature shared with [Far Range Branch Line](./Far%20Range%20Branch%20Line.md).

The section from the transitional cave system to Forester's Hermitage is the section that [Mackenzie](./Will%20Mackenzie.md) runs through in the beginning of [Episode 4](./Episode%204%20-%20Fury%2C%20Then%20Silence.md).

**Description:** A small crossroads in the mountains connecting [Milton](./Milton.md), [Blackrock](./Blackrock.md) and [Pleasant Valley](./Pleasant%20Valley.md)
**Connecting Regions:** [Pleasant Valley](./Pleasant%20Valley.md) [Blackrock](./Blackrock.md) (via [Keeper's Pass North](./Keeper%27s%20Pass%20North.md) )

**Keeper's Pass South** is the 4th Transition Zone [Region](./Region.md) added to _[The Long Dark](./The%20Long%20Dark.md)_. A [Cave](./Cave%20%28Transition%20Zone%29.md) connects to [Keeper's Pass North](./Keeper%27s%20Pass%20North.md) (and later [Blackrock](./Blackrock.md)) with a road leading to [Pleasant Valley](./Pleasant%20Valley.md).

It is a continuation of the road at [Long Curve](./Long%20Curve.md), and contains a scenic stop with a trailer, cars, and little loot. A crossroads connects to the tunnel leading to [Milton](./Milton.md), but the tunnel has collapsed. Further down the road past a bridge is the road to Blackrock, but an avalanche has blocked all progress, forcing the player to go around via a Cave system to reach Keeper's Pass North.

A [Fishing Hut](./Fishing%20Hut.md) can be found on the frozen river and the ice can be fished with Free Form Holes. Many wolves usually wander the river area, and many [Rose Hip](./Rose%20Hip.md) bushes and [Reishi Mushrooms](./Reishi%20Mushroom.md) can be found in the hills.

The frozen river has patches of open ice in it. Stepping on them results in a [Weak Ice](./Weak%20Ice.md) warning. Walking straight into the open water will immediately cause the player to plunge into the water as though they fell through weak ice (this is similar to walking into the ocean edge in coastal regions).
- [Rabbit](./Rabbit.md) can occasionally be found near the river leading to the Cave system.

The beginning of [Episode 3: Crossroads Elegy](./Episode%203%20-%20Crossroads%20Elegy.md) takes place near the tunnel to Milton as [Molly](./Molly.md) finds [Astrid Greenwood](./Astrid%20Greenwood.md). This cutscene introduced Keeper's Pass South 2 years before the region was added to the game.

**Ketchup Chip** is a packaged [food](./Food%20And%20Drink.md) item in [_The Long Dark_](./The%20Long%20Dark.md).

Consuming Ketchup Chips provides up to 300 calories of [energy](./Hunger.md), at the cost of minor [dehydration](./Thirst.md). They are relatively common and weigh a mere 0.10 kg, making its energy density a high 3,000 calories-per-kilogram.
Ketchup Chips do not cause [Food Poisoning](./Food%20Poisoning.md) above 20% condition and [decay](./Decay.md) more slowly when stored outdoors, like other non-canned foods.
- Ketchup Chips were first introduced for the limited time "[Winter's Embrace](./Winter%27s%20Embrace.md)" event (June 29th - July 31st, 2020), along with [Maple Syrup](./Maple%20Syrup.md).
- During the event, eating 25 Ketchup Chips and 25 Maple Syrup, awarded the "Canadian Feast Badge".
- The Ketchup Chips is packaged as a product called "_Chips"_, with a picture of a ketchup bottle branded "K" in front of an image of potato chips.
- The ketchup bottle looks superficially like the glass bottles used by Heinz brand of ketchup, which for years was made in Leamington, Ontario.
- Ketchup Chips are readily available in Canada, but almost unheard of in most other countries.

A **Keypad** is a small electronic panel with numbers on it used to open certain electronically locked doors, but are unpowered during the day.

During an [Aurora](./Aurora.md) the Keypad is powered, but interacting with the it will produce an error noise. Finding the note with the code and then inputting the code will open the door. At this point the door remains permanantly unlocked even when the pad loses power or the door is closed again. Keypads appear in [Survival Mode](./Survival%20Mode.md) and [Wintermute](./Wintermute.md).

Note that the player does not need to carry the note that the code is on, but merely needs to read it, though carrying the note is always the safest option. The player cannot manually input the code on the keys of the Keypad, only interact with the pad as a single object.

- The [Workshop](./Workshop.md) door at [Cannery Pier](./Cannery%20Pier.md) at the [Last Resort Cannery](./Last%20Resort%20Cannery.md) in [Bleak Inlet](./Bleak%20Inlet.md) (code is in [Echo One Radio Tower](./Echo%20One%20Radio%20Tower.md))
- A locked storage room near the [Steam Tunnels](./Steam%20Tunnels.md) at [Blackrock Prison](./Blackrock%20Prison.md) in [Blackrock](./Blackrock.md) (code is in [Last Prospect](./Last%20Prospect.md))

Both doors require a code to open them, and contain a room with the [Milling Machine](./Milling%20Machine.md), [Ammunition Work Bench](./Ammunition%20Work%20Bench.md), and [Ammunition Forge](./Ammunition%20Forge.md), being the only places to find them in Survival Mode.
In Wintermute, only [Episode 2: Luminance Fugue](./Episode%202%20-%20Luminance%20Fugue.md) has Keypads:

- The [Aurora Hatch](./Aurora%20Hatch.md) requires an Aurora to open the hatch, and a code to open the door to the back room (code is near a [Hidden Cache](./Hidden%20Cache.md) near [Hunting Lodge](./Hunting%20Lodge.md))

- The Control room of the [Carter Hydro Dam](./Carter%20Hydro%20Dam.md) requires a code and Aurora in order to progress the Episode during the mission [Renewed Hope](./Renewed%20Hope.md). (code is given when progressing the story)

A **Laceration** may be inflicted during a [Struggle](./Struggle.md). Lacerations instantly damage condition but do not require any treatment to remove, and because of this it never appears directly on the afflictions menu.
The player can receive a Laceration during a [Struggle](./Struggle.md) with a [Bear](./Bear.md), [Timberwolf](./Timberwolf.md), [Poisoned Wolf](./Poisoned%20Wolf.md), or [Wolf](./Wolf.md).
-10% to -15% instant condition loss. Cannot be treated and disappears immediately after being inflicted.

- Updated the First Aid system. Replaced the previous First Aid interface and also extended the First Aid system to support multiple afflictions per type (ex. multiple simultaneous blood loss events), as well as added new afflictions/injuries including Wrist Sprains, Lacerations/Bruising, and Hypothermia.

The lake cabins are located along the southern shore of [Mystery Lake](./Mystery%20Lake%20%28location%29.md). The cabins can be looted for a moderate number of items. They also provide good protection from the elements. Each cabin has a [bunk bed](./Bed.md), and a couple containers

Each of the cabins had a chance of being "ruined" in which their roofs will have collapse and they will be inaccessible. The cabins that are inaccessible varies between each game saves. Difficulty can affect how many of the cabins are ruined, with a max of 5/6 being ruin-able
Beware of [wolves](./Wolf.md) that commonly patrol north of the cabins, and wolves that may wander in from the lake.
- [Fire](./Fire.md) starting materials (e.g., matches, [accelerant](./Accelerant.md), tinder)
- A [hatchet](./Hatchet.md) can be found near a backpack by the second set of lake cabins
- In episode 2 of story mode, two of the accessible Lake Cabins (as well as the [Lone Lake Cabin](./Lone%20Lake%20Cabin.md)) need a key to be unlocked.

There are a number of ways to reach this cave from the entrance to the Hushed River Valley.

One method is to head eastwards from [Stairsteps Lake](./Stairsteps%20Lake.md) to [Many Falls Vista](./Many%20Falls%20Vista.md) and climb down towards [Twin Sisters Falls](./Twin%20Sisters%20Falls.md). From there, head northwards towards [Valley Cave](./Valley%20Cave.md), and turn right at the cliff-face. Climbing two ropes will allow the player to reach [Pensive Vista](./Pensive%20Vista.md), from which Lake Cave is a short stroll northwards. This method is good if one wishes to explore the eastern part of the region and search [Moose Overlook](./Moose%20Overlook.md) for a possible [bow](./Survival%20Bow.md) and [the Landslide](./Landslide%20%28Hushed%20River%20Valley%29.md) for a possible [Hidden Cache](./Hidden%20Cache.md), but requires three rope climbs, and is nearly impossible to complete in one day.

Another way to get to Lake Cave is to head due northward from [Cloudtop Falls](./Cloudtop%20Falls.md) and pass right below the foot of [Offset Falls](./Offset%20Falls.md). Heading north and then northeast from there will lead the player past a small frozen pond and one of the entrances to the [Ice caves](./Ice%20Cave.md) to a climbing rope. Heading eastwards will lead past [Mammoth Falls](./Mammoth%20Falls.md) and [Quarreling Falls](./Quarrelling%20Falls.md) and straight towards Lake Cave. This is a very direct and easy to navigate route, but players will have to be mindful of [wolves](./Wolf.md) and possibly a [bear](./Bear.md).

The final way to get here is to head northwards from [Stairsteps Lake](./Stairsteps%20Lake.md) towards the [Hushed River](./Hushed%20River.md) and enter the ice cave located next to [Reclusive Falls](./Reclusive%20Falls.md). From there, the player will have to navigate the cave until they reach a room with a [Mountaineering Rope](./Mountaineering%20Rope.md). After the climb, leave the cave and turn left. From there a walk eastwards will lead to [Monolith Lake](./Monolith%20Lake.md) and Lake Cave. While this method is the safest from predators and weather, there is a risk of getting lost in the ice caves if one doesn't bring a light source.

A [Frozen Corpse](./Frozen%20Corpse.md) usually spawns here, along with a [Backpack](./Backpack.md) and [Campfire](./Campfire.md), and one of the few ravaged wolf carcasses in the game. Occasionally two cured guts and a cured wolf pelt may be found in the cave, as well as various items of food and drink and a [Research Book](./Research%20Book.md). [Rifle Ammunition](./Rifle%20Ammunition.md) and [Revolver Ammunition](./Revolver%20Ammunition.md) spawn here on occasion too. Sometimes, a [Revolver](./Revolver.md) may be found here.

This cave can be very useful for hunting the [Moose](./Moose.md) that spawns nearby on [Monolith Lake](./Monolith%20Lake.md), as it is too small for the moose to fit into. The cave can also be used in order to cure hides, as it is considered to be a sheltered cave.

Because predators don't spawn near the cave and there's lots of rabbits to snare nearby on the east end of Monolith Lake, some players may find that it makes for a decent safehouse. This is especially true if one has killed the moose on the lake. With the addition of free-form [Ice Fishing](./Ice%20Fishing.md), this cave has become even more useful, as [Monolith Lake](./Monolith%20Lake.md) is the only spot in the region that's deep enough for fishing, and living here allows fishing just outside one's doorstep. One disadvantage of this cave is that it's very noisy, due to the waterfall nearby. If the sound bothers the player, [Pensive Vista](./Pensive%20Vista.md) may be a quieter option.

- Given the ravaged wolf carcass that often spawns in this cave, along with the wolf pelt and guts, it's highly likely that [the survivor](./Frozen%20Corpse.md) attempting to live here was killed by [Intestinal Parasites](./Intestinal%20Parasites.md) from eating too much [Wolf Meat (Raw)](./Wolf%20Meat%20%28Raw%29.md).
- This also explains the general lack of wolves in the area around [Monolith Lake](./Monolith%20Lake.md), as they were likely all hunted.

> “**You found a note with some details on possible Forest Talker activity around Mystery Lake.**”

**Lake Gunshots** is a side mission in [Episode 2](./Episode%202%20-%20Luminance%20Fugue.md) of the [Wintermute](./Wintermute.md). In this mission, [Mackenzie](./Will%20Mackenzie.md) investigates the [Forest Talkers](./Forest%20Talkers.md).
The Quest is unlocked by finding a note [Crumpled Note (2)](./Crumpled%20Note%20%282%29.md) in the [Maintenance Yard](./Maintenance%20Yard.md) in the [Broken Railroad](./Broken%20Railroad.md) region.
- Go to the dam and retrieve the documents. Search under a [Loose Tile](./Loose%20Tile.md) at the bottom of the stairs leading to the admin area.
- Head to the far side of [Mystery Lake](./Mystery%20Lake%20%28location%29.md), near the cabins.

- Pick up the [Logging Camp Trailer Key](./Logging%20Camp%20Trailer%20Key.md) and find the [Forest Talker Supplies](./Forest%20Talker%20Supplies.md) in the [Logging Camp](./Logging%20Camp.md) trailer.

- Go to the [Dam](./Carter%20Hydro%20Dam.md) and retrieve the [Forest Talker Documents](./Forest%20Talker%20Documents.md). Search under a loose tile at the bottom of the stairs leading to the admin area.
- You will face a choice determining your reward. Take the ammo (2 [Rifle Ammunition](./Rifle%20Ammunition.md)) and leave the supplies or just leave the supplies.

- If you choose to take ammo out, the Forest Talker will die and will have [Blood Soaked Forest Talker Documents](./Blood%20Soaked%20Forest%20Talker%20Documents.md) on him. Otherwise, you will get new [Deerskin Pants](./Deerskin%20Pants.md). Both outcomes always leave a [Forest Talker Note](./Forest%20Talker%20Note.md) for Mackenzie inside the cabin, but with a different message depending on what choice you made.
_Mackenzie heads to the lake cabins after reading the Crumpled Note, and finds crows flying over the lake ice, circling a body with blood all around it._

_A trail of fresh blood leads away from the man's corpse, suggesting another Forest Talker is nearby. The blood trail leads to a locked cabin door. Mackenzie interacts with the door and hears a voice._
Mackenzie: "It's ok...I'm not here to take anything from you. Are you with the Forest Talkers?"
Forest Talker: "I am... but I'm not letting you in, they killed my friend. How do I know you aren't one of them?"
Mackenzie: "You don't, but I'm not. Name's Mackenzie. And I'm way too stubborn to just leave you out here all by yourself. You'll have to trust me."
Forest Talker: "Seems like I don't have much of a choice. We left most of our supplies at the old Logging Camp while we fished here. Can you get them for me?"

Forest Talker: "There's more. In that abandoned dam...we found evidence that proves there shouldn't be logging in Mystery Lake. I need that evidence. Documents nobody wanted to be found. We hid them until we could retrieve them. Under a floor tile at the bottom of the stairwell. If you could help me get the documents back...wow, it would be a huge win for the environment. If you care about, you know, living in the world."
Mackenzie: "I have a feeling "the world" has bigger problems right now, but I'll see what I can do."
Forest Talker: "Here's the key to the trailer where we stashed our supplies. I'll slide it under the door."
_Mackenzie takes the key out of the snow in front of the door. If the player checks the door again before finishing the Forest Talker's tasks, this exchange occurs:_
Forest Talker: "Did you find our stuff yet? The supplies? And the documents? I need them both."

_Mackenzie heads to the [Logging Camp](./Logging%20Camp.md), and unlocks a door with the key, taking the [Forest Talker Supplies](./Forest%20Talker%20Supplies.md). Then he heads to the Carter Hydro Dam and finds the Loose Tile mentioned, and finds the [Forest Talker Documents](./Forest%20Talker%20Documents.md)._
Forest Talker: "Hey...that's great. Thank you. But...I hope you understand if I ask you to just leave them outside the door."
_Two options appear on the screen. Choosing to take the man's ammo will have consequences later._

This location includes a cave and a spot which overlooks [Mystery Lake (location)](./Mystery%20Lake%20%28location%29.md). There is a [Rabbit](./Rabbit.md) grove as well as [Old Man's Beard Lichen](./Old%20Man%27s%20Beard%20Lichen.md) near the cave and a [Deer Carcass](./Deer%20Carcass.md) may be found near the ledge. Inside the cave there may be a [body](./Frozen%20Corpse.md) along with firewood and assorted items, including a possible revolver. The Lake Overlook is a possible Mystery Lake vista location.

This can be a very useful location for fighting Cabin Fever in Interloper if the player uses [Camp Office](./Camp%20Office.md) as [Safe House](./Safehouse.md), as the cave provides a warmth bonus. Furthermore, the rabbit grove is far from any predators, and the deer carcass can also be harvested relatively safely.

![Green are rope climb spots, orange area outlines accessible area after the first climb, orange circle is the entrance to the cave, the arrow points the direction to location discovery.](../assets/Lake_Overview.jpg)_Green are rope climb spots, orange area outlines accessible area after the first climb, orange circle is the entrance to the cave, the arrow points the direction to location discovery._ The most direct route to reach the location is to climb two ropes up from near Mystery's Lake's southern access (along the river). There is a camping spot on the ledge between the two climbs. The other ways to reach the location involve hiking, either up through the forest opposite the Camp Office, or along the ridge from the direction of the Log Sort. ![20160516235337 1](../assets/20160516235337_1.jpg) ![20160516235354 1](../assets/20160516235354_1.jpg)
It is assumed it was added with the Tireless Menace update, since it was discovered as late as 16 May 2016.

**Lake Whitefish (Cooked)** is a cooked [food](./Food%20And%20Drink.md) item in _The Long Dark_.

Lake Whitefish are small freshwater fish found commonly in lakes and ponds. They can be caught by [Ice Fishing](./Ice%20Fishing.md) using [Fishing Tackle](./Fishing%20Tackle.md). Lake Whitefish can be between 1.5 and 2.3 kg raw.
At 0% condition food disappears if inside of a container, but not outside of containers or in the player's inventory.

Cooking Whitefish takes 20+ minutes and is be obtained by using a lit [fire](./Fire.md). Cooking increases it's condition by 50%, decays 4 times slower than raw meat, and has a reduces chance of [Food Poisoning](./Afflictions.md) over raw meat, but decreasing it's weight by 35%. Cooked whitefish's energy density is 385 calories-per-kilogram. Cooking fish also yields a small amount of [Lantern Fuel](./Lantern%20Fuel.md).

Cooking whitefish improves the [Cooking Skill](./Skills.md#Cooking). Using a [Cooking Pot](./Cooking%20Pot.md) reduces cooking time by 25%. Cooking food for too long will burn it. Destroying the item and damaging a Cooking Pot if used.

The Landslide blocks the train tracks, forcing the player to go into the nearby frozen pond and over a tree bridge to get around it entering Broken Railroad. The nearby lower pond often contains a [Wolf](./Wolf.md) hunting [Rabbits](./Rabbit.md). However, when exiting Broken Railroad, the player can climb over the landslide, saving time and [Fatigue](./Fatigue.md).
Contrary to a first glance, the Landslide can be bypassed by simply walking up to the rocks and walking over it, saving time from having to go into the nearby pond.

Due to the extreme length and dangers of the mine, it is advised to prepare oneself for exploration by:
- Bringing extra light sources such as [Flares](./Flare.md), a [Flashlight](./Flashlight.md), a [Torch](./Torch.md), or [Storm Lantern](./Storm%20Lantern.md) to avoid being trapped in the darkness.

- Bringing a [Respirator](./Respirator.md) and a light stockpile of [Canisters](./Canister.md), which is a must for passing through certain areas of the mine in order to avoid [Suffocation](./Suffocation.md). While many polluted areas of the mine can be quickly sprinted through to avoid dying, some areas cannot be thoroughly explored without a reliable source of oxygen.
- Leaving behind heavy weapons and tools to aid mobility, as there are no predators skulking the tunnels.
- Having a Flashlight to see further ahead than a Storm Lantern during an [Aurora](./Aurora.md)/[Glimmer Fog](./Glimmer%20Fog.md) event; this can often make traveling the mines much easier.
- Leaving behind [Jerry Cans](./Jerry%20Can.md), [Emergency Stims](./Emergency%20Stim.md), and the bulk of one's Canisters, as these are quite plentiful on all floors of the Mine.

- Using [Spray Paint](./Spray%20Paint.md) to create directional arrows as well as lighting [Lanterns](./Lantern.md) occasionally found throughout the walls of the mine, which can provide valuable points of reference to avoid getting lost when exploring.
- Bringing a [Bedroll](./Bedroll.md) if you wish to rest in other parts of the mine. If not, there is one bed in the mine near the third level of the elevator.
- [Campfires](./Campfire.md) cannot be started in the mine, but [Fire Barrels](./Fire%20Barrel.md) can be found at various places to cook food.
- A mountainside entrance near the 6th floor of the [Concentrator](./Concentrator.md) (locked but can be opened as part of Buried Echoes)
- The Elevator shaft in the [Headframe Building](./Headframe%20Building.md) has 3 entrances that lead to Levels 1, 2, and 3
The levels in the mine are numerous, large and confusing. It is very easy to find yourself trapped or running in circles. Levels may be further split into different isolated sections.
[Fire Barrels](./Fire%20Barrel.md) and [Lanterns](./Lantern.md) can be found scattered around the tunnels and caverns, usually at junctions.

This "Level" is only opened as part of the Tale Buried Echoes Tale. It has two entry points, one from the locked gate in the mountainside entrance near the 6th floor of the Concentrator, and the other via a locked gate on Level 1 below the Conveyor Room.
The key to the mountain entrance can be found deeper in Level 3 after progressing the Buried Echoes. The lower entrance can be unlocked **after** completing the Tale.
Level 1 is accessible from the elevator shaft of the Headframe Building and via the conveyor from the [Conveyor Room](./Conveyor%20Room.md).

When coming from the elevator and keeping to the left, a small cabin can be found. Inside is a locked lockbox that can be opened with a [Mine Lockbox Key](./Mine%20Lockbox%20Key.md). The key can be looted from a corpse found on the same level, but you will need to navigate through toxic gas to reach it. The lockbox contains cash and a [Gold Nugget](./Gold%20Nugget.md).

Level 2 is only accessible from the elevator shaft of the headframe building. This level is characterized by a large crushing machine, presumably used to crush chunks of rock to extract uranium ore/Coal. The area around it has a [Fire Barrel](./Fire%20Barrel.md) and a [Work Bench](./Work%20Bench.md). An accessible (but one-way) chute leads down from the bottom of the machine into Level 3.
There are 3 entrances: from the elevator of the Headframe Building, from the open pit mine, and from Miner's Footpath.

Close to the entrance from Miner's Footpath there is a short rope climb that blocks the path into the mine. This section of the mine has several wooden bridges suspended over deep chasms. The survivor needs to watch their step here, as a fall will result in death. Further on, Wooden [Planks](./Planks.md) block the path to the rest of the mine, and need to be broken down with a [Hatchet](./Hatchet.md) or a [Heavy Hammer](./Heavy%20Hammer.md) in order to proceed.

In the center of the level, where the chute from level 2 ends, is another cavern. The cavern contains a Fire Barrel, Lantern and a locked room. This room is the mining office, which can be unlocked with the [Mine Office Key](./Mine%20Office%20Key.md). On lower difficulties, a [Hunting Rifle](./Hunting%20Rifle.md) with ammo and other supplies can be found inside. On Interloper, the rifle will be replaced by a [Distress Pistol](./Distress%20Pistol.md) with several shells.

The cavern around the elevator has many walkways with several mining cabins with good loot. One of the unlocked cabins contains a bed. The area also has a [Work Bench](./Work%20Bench.md) and [Fire Barrel](./Fire%20Barrel.md).

West of the main elevator is large cavern with a skylight and a chemical pool at the bottom. Continuing along the walkway will take you to a cavern with two gates, one of which is locked; it can be opened by using the [Bolt Cutters](./Bolt%20Cutters.md) after having progressed enough through Buried Echoes.

Continuing further through more toxic gas will bring you across some [Supply Bins](./Supply%20Bin.md) and two corpses. The corpse in the section with the low ceiling carries the [Mine Office Key](./Mine%20Office%20Key.md). You can continue further into a crawlspace to reach the pit entrance.
_A photo of the Langston Mine in the [Vacant Depot](./Vacant%20Depot.md) in [Transfer Pass](./Transfer%20Pass.md)_

**Lantern Fuel** is a container of kerosene fuel for the [Storm Lantern](./Storm%20Lantern.md). It can also be used as an optional accelerant for starting fires or an ingredient for crafting a [Torch](./Torch.md).

Unlike the [Jerry Can](./Jerry%20Can.md), when the container is emptied, it is spontaneously removed from the player's inventory and spontaneously generated when harvesting a storm lantern or cooking fish when no Jerry Can is in the player's inventory.

Jerry Cans are noticeably more efficient per kilogram than Lantern Fuel, weighing only 0.4 kg per 0.5 liters collected, while Lantern Fuel weighs 0.5 kg per 0.5 liters collected, the 0.1kg is a static addition, with even 0.04l still weighing 0.14kg. As such fully depleting a fuel package by refueling a lantern with it, decreases the weight in backpack by 0.10kg, presumably by throwing away the packaging.

Refueling a lantern with both a Jerry Can and Lantern Fuel in the player's inventory will use the Jerry Can first. Therefore it is best to drop the Jerry Can before refueling so the Lantern Fuel is used first. It is also better to use up multiple emptier packages than one full one.
Bottles of Lantern Fuel can usually be found fairly frequently throughout the world, most often in houses and cabins. They an also be created by cooking [fish](./Ice%20Fishing.md).
| [Torch](./Torch.md) | None | - 3 × [Stick](./Stick.md) - 1 × [Cloth](./Cloth.md) - 0.10 L × [Lantern Fuel](./Lantern%20Fuel.md) |
- Lantern Fuel features the fictional brand name "Ever-Flame," and the container lists the volume as "350mL" or 0.35 L.
- [Coho Salmon](./Coho%20Salmon%20%28Raw%29.md) is the most efficient fish for the production of lantern fuel, due to its large weight and high yield per kg.
- It weights as same with [Jerry Can](./Jerry%20Can.md) when emptied, which is ironic because of the size difference

Yes **Lanterns** are stationary light-producing objects in _The Long Dark._ For the hand-held light source, see [Storm Lantern](./Storm%20Lantern.md).

Lanterns are stationary objects which can be lit (taking ~1 in-game minute) to provide light to the surrounding area but no additional [Warmth](./Warmth.md). They do not require a [starter](./Fire%20Starting.md) to ignite or consume [fuel](./Lantern%20Fuel.md) to burn, and cannot be looted or moved. Interacting with a lit Lantern grants the option to extinguish it. Lighting lanterns can be useful for navigation, conserving fuel and determining where the survivor has traveled.
- [Wintermute](./Wintermute.md) Episode 4 [Fury, Then Silence](./Episode%204%20-%20Fury%2C%20Then%20Silence.md) at the [Steam Tunnels](./Steam%20Tunnels.md) in [Blackrock](./Blackrock.md).
- [Survival](./Survival%20Mode.md) Mode inside the [Langston Mine](./Langston%20Mine.md) in [Zone of Contamination](./Zone%20of%20Contamination.md).

**Last Horizon** is the third [Tale](./Tales.md) released for the [Tales from the Far Territory](./Tales%20from%20the%20Far%20Territory.md) addon in [Survival Mode](./Survival%20Mode.md). As of V 2.27, Last Horizon can be started on a new playthrough out of order as soon as the [Handheld Shortwave Radio](./Handheld%20Shortwave%20Radio.md) is acquired, as long as [Signal Void](./Signal%20Void.md), [Buried Echoes](./Buried%20Echoes.md), and Last Horizon have been completed on another playthrough and their associated [Badges](./Badges.md) are acquired. The [Transmitter](./Transmitters.md) in [Forsaken Airfield](./Forsaken%20Airfield.md) will need to be repaired before this Tale can be started if played out of order, and [Bunker Omega](./Bunker%20Omega.md) will need to be uncovered to finish it. ![Cougar Part 5](../assets/Cougar_Part_5.jpg)
_This section may contain spoilers from the [story](./Wintermute.md) of The Long Dark._

Continuing the events of the last Tale, the survivor buries the remains of the Security Chief and follows a nearby pass from [Enduring Waterfall](./Enduring%20Waterfall.md) into a hidden mountain installation, then sets out to find any evidence of Rüdiger's escape. Head to [Sundered Pass](./Sundered%20Pass.md), where a Weather Station that was mentioned in the Security Chief's notes may hold clues as to the fate of Rüdiger, along with any successful results of his project.
- Reach the Weather Station and search the area using the Handheld Shortwave during an [aurora](./Aurora.md).
- Use the Polaroid and Key to find the [Foreman's Refuge](./Foreman%27s%20Refuge.md) in Sundered Pass.
- Use the Polaroid and Handheld Shortwave to locate Rüdiger's Hideout in Sundered Pass.
- Reach the High Peak Plateau and and look for signs of Rüdiger and the Foreman. [0/2]
- Return to the [Omega Bunker](./Bunker%20Omega.md) and investigate the area shown in the Polaroid.

After burying the [The Security Chief's Remains](./The%20Security%20Chief%27s%20Remains.md) at [Enduring Waterfall](./Enduring%20Waterfall.md), the only thing left to do is find out where Rüdiger may have gone. [Security Chief's Log 33](./Security%20Chief%27s%20Log%2033.md) mentions that Rüdiger had an escape plan in the form of a transmission site over the mountains after the failure of The Machine in the [Langston Mine](./Langston%20Mine.md), in the region known as [Sundered Pass](./Sundered%20Pass.md).

- Follow the river downstream of the falls to the cave. Proceed through the cavern until you come across a natural bridge made of stone over a bottomless pit. You'll know you're going the right way if you come across a mountain rope climbing section and a large frozen waterfall.

- Head east back to the tracks and return to the [Vacant Depot](./Vacant%20Depot.md) in [Transfer Pass](./Transfer%20Pass.md). The road behind the old train station has a sign with scratched out text (Likely Rüdiger covering his tracks) that leads up into the mountains and into a collapsed tunnel. Climb the nearby rope to bypass the tunnel and head into the Pass.
**This guide will be choosing the Vacant Depot route, however, one of the possible routes leads past the exit of the transfer cave.**

Make sure you have enough warm clothing, supplies, and weapons for this trip, as Sundered Pass is not for the faint of heart; with few shelters, very cold weather, and [Timberwolf](./Timberwolf.md) packs spread out across the region. Travel by day, or night if you must, and wait until the [Aurora](./Aurora.md)/[Glimmer Fog](./Glimmer%20Fog.md) appears. Regardless of what path you take, your objective is to reach a [Weather Station](./Weather%20Station.md) in the mountains.

violations.context: **Option 1: The road throughout the mountains**

When you enter Sundered Pass, turn right at the fork and you will reach the other side of the collapsed tunnel from Transfer Pass. Continue following the road throughout the mountains. You will cross [Baneful Bridge](./Baneful%20Bridge.md) and eventually find Refuge Shelter A, [Lotte's Rest](./Lotte%27s%20Rest.md). Rest up here if you need to and continue to follow the road. If your [Handheld Shortwave Radio](./Handheld%20Shortwave%20Radio.md) is active, by the time you pass [Cascading Gap](./Cascading%20Gap.md), it will start detecting a signal on the blue setting. Follow it.

Walking into a large field (filled with Timberwolves so beware) past Refuge Cabin B, [Placid Notch](./Placid%20Notch.md), you'll see a shiny Radar Dome high above on a large plateau, but following the road there meets you with a problem, an impassable collapsed bridge. Walking behind the plateau (and likely fighting more Timberwolf packs) does not yield an entrance to the Weather Station, so keep heading west past the pond where you will eventually pass through a cave with running water. Past this cave is a fork in the road, head left to a rickety rope bridge, [Perilous Crossing](./Perilous%20Crossing.md). If you headed left and went past a [Rock Climb](./Rock%20Climb.md), you went the wrong way. Climb a final Rope Climb and you'll reach the top at [Second Pillar](./Second%20Pillar.md).

**Note:** This route is harder to find, and there is less shelter on the way. It is highly recommended to take it only if you carry little weight, have some fuel to make a fire and coffee and an [Insulated Flask](./Insulated%20Flask.md) to keep you warm. There will be no timberwolves through this route.

When you arrive from Transfer pass, turn left and go down into the forest. Watch out for the wolves in the forest. Stick to the mountain wall to your left, and eventually you will find the [Last Lonely House](./Last%20Lonely%20House.md). Use the opportunity to warm up and maybe heat up some coffee for the Insulated Flask.
To the west of the house is a slope that leads to a climbing rope spot. Climb it and you will end up in the mountains on the western most portion of the map.

At some point you will see the transition cave to [Forsaken Airfield](./Forsaken%20Airfield.md) and [Zone of Contamination](./Zone%20of%20Contamination.md) on your left, you can warm up in there and also find some coal. If you took the way through the transition cave you will come out here.

Continue to forward past a tree bridge and over a Rock Climb, and eventually you will reach an intersection. The way to your left leads into an open cave and is the way you will come up from if you take Option one. Take the path in front of you, it leads over a suspension bridge, [Perilous Crossing](./Perilous%20Crossing.md), then you have to climb a final rope to Second Pillar to reach the Weather Station.

Searching the 3 buildings at the outpost does not yield anything useful for the investigation (besides a [Bloody note](./Notes.md)). Remember the signal that lead you here? The Handheld Shortwave is always the key, so wait until it is powered and then search the area. Hold up in the [Station Bunkhouse](./Station%20Bunkhouse.md) until then.

When the Radio is powered, it will point in the direction next of a small ledge near the Radar building. Dig through the snow to uncover a [Lock Box](./Lock%20Box.md) and [Foreman's Technical Log 1](./Foreman%27s%20Technical%20Log%201.md). Inside the Lock Box is [An Old House Key](./An%20Old%20House%20Key.md) and some other loot. After listening to the Foreman's log, the survivor will open the clipboard box to find [Foreman's Polaroid 1](./Foreman%27s%20Polaroid%201.md) inside, with a photo of a small cabin.

The text on the back of the Polaroid mentions a forest below the treeline, which can be seen slightly southwest of your position if you walk back to the Second Pillar. Make your way there via the rope bridge and continue past the Transition Cave that leaves the region (rest here if you need to). Climb down the Rope Climbing section and near the bottom you will find the [Last Lonely House](./Last%20Lonely%20House.md). The front door is unlocked but the door to the bedroom is not, requiring An Old House Key.

The bedroom has the following loot: [Foreman's Technical Log 2](./Foreman%27s%20Technical%20Log%202.md), a [Safe](./Safe.md), and under the bed are the unique [Tactical Gloves](./Tactical%20Gloves.md).

Grab the Technical Log and yet another Polaroid is inside, [Foreman's Polaroid 2](./Foreman%27s%20Polaroid%202.md), pointing to a ruined building that the Foreman believed to be Rüdiger's Hideout, a building out in the field near Refuge Cabin B [Placid Notch](./Placid%20Notch.md), in a place called [Old Settlement](./Old%20Settlement.md).

Travel south from the door of the Last Lonely House to return back to the collapsed tunnel leading to Transfer Pass, and then follow the road up the mountains out into the field (avoiding Timberwolf packs along the way). Wait inside Placid Notch until the Handheld Shortwave becomes active, and then follow the signal. Unlike the Weather Station signal, this location has a very short detection range.

Behind the ruined building, near the bathroom, is a large mound of snow. Uncover it to find a pair of doors that lead to the building's [Basement](./Basement%20%28Sundered%20Pass%29.md). Look in the back for a table near the [Bed](./Bed.md), where you will find [Rüdiger's Diary 1](./R%C3%BCdiger%27s%20Diary%201.md) and [Foreman's Polaroid 5](./Foreman%27s%20Polaroid%205.md). Rüdiger was aware that someone was stalking him, and he fled to somewhere higher in the region to get a signal for help. The Foreman was also here and left another Polaroid, pointing towards a settlement past a lake, the "high point" Rüdiger mentioned fleeing to.

Leave the Basement when **fully rested**, travel north up the road to [Final Refuge](./Final%20Refuge.md) or the [Fishing Hut](./Fishing%20Hut.md) ([Ambler's Lake](./Ambler%27s%20Lake.md)) to get around the avalanche ([Unyielding Inundation](./Unyielding%20Inundation.md)), down a long valley will lead to shear cliff and a upward [rope climb](./Rope%20Climbing.md): **this climb is very long and with no ledges to rest**. **It is so long that it is possible to run out of Stamina without the use of an [Emergency Stim](./Emergency%20Stim.md) or [Crampons](./Crampons.md) or [Improvised Crampons](./Improvised%20Crampons.md)**.

At the top of this climb is [Roamer's Cave](./Roamer%27s%20Cave.md), a [rabbit grove](./Rabbit%20Grove.md) and burned trailer for [reclaimed wood](./Reclaimed%20Wood.md). After you rest from the long climb, follow the wooden steps up to the Polaroid's location and clear the snow out to proceed.

The journey ahead will be extremely cold, becoming colder as The Survivor ascends in elevation and requires three [rope climbs](./Rope%20Climbing.md). Two outdoor caves which provide some warmth and shelter are in the area, and a rock tunnel.

On the other side will be [High Peak Plateau](./High%20Peak%20Plateau.md), with a shed next to a signal dish containing 2 items: [Rüdiger's Diary 2](./R%C3%BCdiger%27s%20Diary%202.md) and [Foreman's Technical Log 3](./Foreman%27s%20Technical%20Log%203.md) (with another Polaroid inside, [Foreman's Polaroid 3](./Foreman%27s%20Polaroid%203.md)). This photo shows an already familiar location you've explored long ago, [Bunker Omega](./Bunker%20Omega.md).
(Note: If you have finished Last Horizon before and are playing Tales out of order, Bunker Omega cannot be opened without first completing [Signal Void](./Signal%20Void.md))

Leaving High Plateau requires descending a [Mountaineering Rope](./Mountaineering%20Rope.md): a spare rope can be looted from the outpost with a signal dish with a rock to attach it to just below the camp. Descending this rope a long, steep slope leads to south-eastern Sundered Pass. The road may be followed to southern Sundered Pass and [Transfer Pass](./Transfer%20Pass.md), or crossing the region to the Far Territory's Transition Cave and to [Forsaken Airfield](./Forsaken%20Airfield.md) or [Zone of Contamination](./Zone%20of%20Contamination.md).

The last step of Final Horizon requires returning to [Bunker Omega](./Bunker%20Omega.md) in Forsaken Airfield. Once inside, head left to the boiler room and in the storage closet a false wooden wall (shown in the Foreman's Polaroid 3) can be interacted with to reveal a hidden room.
- [Rüdiger's Diary 3](./R%C3%BCdiger%27s%20Diary%203.md) on the left console above the remains
- [Foreman's Technical Log 4](./Foreman%27s%20Technical%20Log%204.md) across from the remains on the wooden table (with [Foreman's Polaroid 4](./Foreman%27s%20Polaroid%204.md) inside)

- [Security Chief's ID Badge](./Security%20Chief%27s%20ID%20Badge.md) also on the wooden table (Picking up the badge will instantly unlock the [Feats](./Feats.md) Settled Mind and Celestial Navigator)
- [Rüdiger's Watch](./R%C3%BCdiger%27s%20Watch.md) hidden under the chair behind the remains

Rüdiger's Diary reveals his goal on [Great Bear Island](./Great%20Bear%20Island.md) was an effort to prepare human civilization for a potential or imminent disaster; however he underestimated The Machine's effects and the Island's unpredictable nature, ultimately resulting in the project failing and the deaths of the team. The Foreman's Log reveals that the skeleton is Rüdiger's who was mauled by a cougar prior to hiding in Bunker Omega, and killed in a struggle with The Foreman. The Foreman composed his final log and left it along with Security Chief's ID Badge and his [Tactical Jacket](./Tactical%20Jacket.md) (except on [Interloper/Misery modes](./Survival%20Mode.md)) before presumably concealing the room. Given that The Foreman is still in pursuit of "The Data" (presumably The Machine's) and that Rüdiger after fleeing Zone of Contamination traveled to the data dish in Sundered Pass, it can be inferred Rüdiger may have transmitted this data to some unknown third party. The Foreman's fate unknown.

After all 4 narrative items are acquired the Tale ends, awarding a [Badge](./Badges.md) and the [Feats: "Celestial Navigator" and "Settled Mind"](./Feats.md), and completing the Tales from the Far Territory.
- Completing Last Horizon unlocks a [Badge](./Badges.md) of the same name, as well as two [Feats](./Feats.md), Settled Mind and Celestial Navigator.

- The name of this Tale, "Last Horizon," is an example of poetic irony, as it is the opposite of Dr. Rüdiger final line in [My Testament](./My%20Testament.md): "Once again. I have seen the new horizon." Rüdiger never lived to see his new horizon by the end of this Tale.

> “**Blackrock's mine was said to be the brainchild of a Mainland consortium. With newer technology, for its time, they hoped to delve deeper than any other mine on the Island. It remains unknown if the mine's ambitious goal is in some way connected to its shuttering.**”

**Last Prospect** is a key location in [The Detonators](./The%20Detonators.md), the fourth mission in [Episode 4: Fury, then Silence](./Episode%204%20-%20Fury%2C%20Then%20Silence.md) in [Wintermute](./Wintermute.md). In [Survival Mode](./Survival%20Mode.md), it contains the keypad code for the [Blackrock Prison](./Blackrock%20Prison.md) workshop door, along with [noisemakers](./Noisemaker.md) that, once picked up, grant the player the blueprint to craft them at the [Ammunition Work Bench](./Ammunition%20Work%20Bench.md).

The Last Prospect gold mine is an abandoned gold mine located in the mountains in the northeast corner of [Blackrock](./Blackrock.md) region. To get there in the story mode, players can travel north along the eastern side of the map on the road, and then cross a ravine at the [Mule Bridge](./Mule%20Bridge.md) to reach one of two entrances. The second entrance to the area requires the player to make two rope climbs from the bottom of the ravine that runs through the center of the region, and is the only entrance that can be accessed in [Survival Mode](./Survival%20Mode.md). The mine contains noisemakers/the blueprint to craft them as well as the key code to the workshop in the prison, the mine is a must-visit for any players staying in Blackrock long term. The lower level can be explored with the aid of the [Elevator Crank](./Elevator%20Crank.md).

Once at the location, the player can enter the mine, which requires a light source to traverse. Traveling deeper into the mine will bring the player to a hand-powered elevator that requires a crank found on a crate nearby. The crank weighs 1 kg in Survival, but is weightless in [Wintermute](./Wintermute.md). The elevator can be used to reach the lowest level of the mine, where the player will then have to deal with poisonous fog and suffocation.

In Story mode, there are multiple sections with fog and short timers, and the player will need to clear sections of fog by opening air valves in order to progress. In Survival, there is only one long section with fog: the timer is generous for this part to compensate for the permadeath aspect. However, players will need to sprint and be unburdened in order to make it through this section safely. Once the player reaches the center floor of the mine, they can return through a different elevator and avoid making a return trip through the fog.

Suffocation risk is a new status introduced in [The Detonators](./The%20Detonators.md) in Wintermute. It then appears again in [Donner](./Donner.md), and makes an appearance in Survival mode in the deepest area of the Last Prospect mine. When entering an area with poisonous fog or smoke, a timer will above the status bars in the bottom left corner of the screen, and the player's vision will begin to blur. If the timer reaches zero while the player is still in an area with fog or smoke, then the player will die _immediately, regardless of [condition](./Condition.md)_. By reaching clean air, the status will be cleared and the timer will disappear. In the mine, this risk appears when the player enters an area with poisonous fog.

In Survival mode, there is ample time to get through the toxic fog as long as the player is not encumbered and can sprint most of, if not all the way. The use of an [Emergency Stim](./Emergency%20Stim.md) or [Go! Energy Drink](./Go!%20Energy%20Drink.md) can help if speed is a concern.

On the top floor, where both entrances into the mine meet, there is a supply closet that contains valuable resources. In Story mode, the closet is locked and requires the player to find clues left by the Forest Talkers throughout the mine. In Survival, this is where the noisemakers can be found. Picking up a noisemaker will unlock the crafting blueprint, allowing the player to make their own.

If the player travels deep into the mine and braves the toxic gases to reach the second floor, they will be rewarded with a note that contains the key code for the workshop door back at the prison. Much like [Bleak Inlet](./Bleak%20Inlet.md), the player needs to retrieve this note and wait for an [Aurora](./Aurora.md) before they can open the door. Once this door has been opened once, it can be opened and closed freely. The workshop, much like the one in Bleak Inlet, contains both an [Ammunition Work Bench](./Ammunition%20Work%20Bench.md) and a [Milling Machine](./Milling%20Machine.md). While the milling machine requires an aurora to use, the ammunition work bench may be used at any time. Unlike Bleak Inlet, a rope climb is not required to reach the workshop, which allows players to lug materials there with greater ease. These advantages mean that, in easier difficulties, when combined with readily available [car batteries](./Car%20Battery.md) to harvest for [Scrap Lead](./Scrap%20Lead.md) and the high spawn rate of [gunpowder](./Can%20of%20Gunpowder.md)/its respective crafting materials throughout the region, it is easy to reach [Gunsmithing](./Gunsmithing.md) 5 and craft a supply of ammunition.

- Bring a [prybar](./Prybar.md) in order to access storage lockers within the mine. There is a possible spawn for one outside the second (collapsed) entrance, near the chain with a bucket. It is NOT guaranteed.

- Access to the mine requires two consecutive [rope climbs](./Rope%20Climbing.md) with a narrow ledge between the two. It is very difficult to rest on this ledge as there are no obstacles available to act as windbreaks for a campfire. Start the climb with full fatigue and stamina, and bring coffee or an energy drink if possible. If you are low on fatigue and stamina, you may be forced to take a dangerously exposed nap on the ledge. The crate beneath the fallen [Mule Bridge](./Mule%20Bridge.md) usually contains the nearest energy drink, but the trail to it is only one way(in the direction of water flow).

- Craft [Improvised Crampons](./Improvised%20Crampons.md) before attempting the journey, with 3 ropes (one down, two up) and then 2 ropes (down) + 1 (up) if you want to climb above [Blackrock Prison](./Blackrock%20Prison.md) to avoid [Timberwolves](./Timberwolf.md) on the way back, they are a sound investment. The [Blackrock Prison](./Blackrock%20Prison.md) and tunnels provide ample [Scrap Metal](./Scrap%20Metal.md) and [Leather](./Cured%20Leather.md)/harvestable footwear.

- There are two routes to reach the bottom of the rope climbs: following the frozen creek upstream from the bridge leading to [Cook's Farm](./Cook%27s%20Farm.md) or by climbing down from [Fool's Corner](./Fool%27s%20Corner.md). The former route is shorter and safer, but you will miss some loot on the eastern side of the region, as a one-way descent prevents access to the uppermost part of the river where the [Fool's Corner](./Fool%27s%20Corner.md) rope is located. Potential loot in this area includes a [Military-Grade MRE](./Military-Grade%20MRE.md) and [Go! Energy Drink](./Go!%20Energy%20Drink.md) inside of a crate underneath the fallen bridge. A [Hunting Rifle](./Hunting%20Rifle.md)/[Rifle Ammunition](./Rifle%20Ammunition.md) can spawn in the collapsed railway tunnel near the bridge connection above the river, and there is also a corpse and backpack at the top of this rope.

- Multiple wolves spawn underneath the rope climbs: try to time your descent to avoid being detected and have a window to react. It might even be easier to kill the wolves before climbing up, as there is a cave nearby for regaining Condition than to risk a surprise confrontation when tired from descending as you will have to travel through here when going back.

Has an interior **Last Resort Cannery** is a major location in [Bleak Inlet](./Bleak%20Inlet.md). The cannery complex features a renewable source of a few important materials, a special workshop with some unique tools, and a trailer that can be used for shelter.

In addition to its numerous amenities, the cannery also features the first example of an obstacle course "puzzle" in Survival mode, as well as an ample supply of its signature product, [Tin of Sardines](./Tin%20of%20Sardines.md), and multiple resident [timberwolf](./Timberwolf.md) packs. Extreme caution is advised when entering the Cannery grounds, as the Timberwolves are numerous and kill quickly.

![Gatehouse](../assets/SS-BI-Cannery-Gatehouse.jpg)_Gatehouse_There is a gatehouse with a door along the road in front of the cannery. It may be a good place for players to fight timberwolves with firearms.

The trailer serves as a useful place to evade [timberwolves](./Timberwolf.md). It contains much of the loot typically found in trailers--a few packaged food items, some clothing, crafting materials, tools, etc. The trailer is also the only easily accessed indoor building in the cannery complex, and thus serves as shelter to rest and recover when necessary.

![SS BI Warehouse02](../assets/SS-BI-Warehouse02.jpg)The cannery has 3 dilapidated warehouses surrounding an open work yard and dock area. The yard contains a few vehicles, some semitrailers, industrial equipment, and several green wooden crates.

Of the warehouses surrounding the area, two are broken down and mostly open to the outdoors; they provide little shelter from the elements but might contain a few supplies. Another warehouse is situated just off the pier and contains the workshop, but it is difficult to access. The other four warehouses are also more difficult to gain entry to and offer some limited protection from the weather.

One of the warehouses has a room around back (off the wrap-around dock) with a door that can be opened and closed. This room is secure enough to protect the player from [timberwolves](./Timberwolf.md), though it may be too cold without warm clothing. Inside the room there may be a few supplies, as well as a fire barrel and a bed.

![Locked door](../assets/SS-BI-Workshop-Keypad.jpg)_Locked door_The Cannery workshop is one of the two locations on [Great Bear Island](./Great%20Bear%20Island.md) that contains an [Ammunition Work Bench](./Ammunition%20Work%20Bench.md) and a [Milling Machine](./Milling%20Machine.md) (the other one being Blackrock).

The workshop is challenging to reach; it is accessed via an [obstacle course](../assets/SS-BI-Cannery-ObstacleCourse.jpg) that starts with climbing the rope located in one of the warehouses on the opposite side of the entrance.

If you follow the linear course all the way through, you will reach the workshop. There is only one path to take, with no major side or alternate paths, and there is only one method to enter the course path. Essentially the only "obstacle" in the course is climbing the rope to start it. Balancing on the beams and rafters throughout the course is fairly easy. Note - the course winds through the complex and does not allow the player to backtrack after passing certain points.

After completing the course, the player can enter the pier warehouse's outer entryway. The way into the workshop is initially blocked by a locked door. The door can only be unlocked using the electronic keypad beside it, which requires a 3-digit code and electricity.

The workshop cannot be accessed through any alternate path, and the key-code cannot be guessed through trial and error. The player must read the Communication Report letter that is inside the [Echo One Radio Tower](./Echo%20One%20Radio%20Tower.md) in [Bleak Inlet](./Bleak%20Inlet.md). You do not need to take the report, but the player character must have seen the code document at least once.

The first time, the player will only be able to enter the workshop during an [aurora](./Aurora.md) when the electronic keypad is active and the code can be entered to unlock the door. ![SS BI Workshop02](../assets/SS-BI-Workshop02.jpg)Once door is unlocked, entrance to the workshop remains unlocked.

Whenever the player passes through the workshop's door, there is a random chance of encountering a wolf. Once the wolf is dealt with, the player will be able to access the milling machine and the ammunition workbench. As the aurora appears frequently in this region, use caution around the live wires scattered about.

![SS BI TimberWolf](../assets/SS-BI-TimberWolf.jpg)The Cannery is usually guarded by one or two packs of [timberwolves](./Timberwolf.md). Extreme caution should be used when nearing the facility complex as the number of timberwolves present could easily overwhelm the player.

Before venturing into the open outdoors in the area, it is advisable to drop any gear that isn't essential, especially before attempting to reach the workshop. The player will have to climb a rope to get away from the timberwolves and get started on the obstacle course. Because you can't climb while encumbered, you will need to be unencumbered to reach the catwalks that make up the first part of the course.

Attempting to start the course unprepared will required the player to drop items at the base of the rope while being circled by timberwolves or abort the attempt to reach the workshop. Failing to drop items to become unencumbered could result in death if the player has no means to escape or drive off the timberwolves.

The Cannery is responsible for producing the packaged food [Tin of Sardines](./Tin%20of%20Sardines.md). Despite the plant having shut down long ago, several Tins of the product are found all over the Cannery, making it a great place to stock up on easy food stuffs (though some tins can be quite low Condition considering the age of the abandoned facility). The number of Tin of Sardines changes depending on the Experience played on, with more appearing on lower difficulties.
They are routinely found on [Pallets](./Pallet.md), on **AND** inside of [Crates](./Crate.md), or just generally out in the open:
- Near a group of barrels buried in the snow, right up against a pile of turned over industrial bins (green crates are nearby for reference)
- Buried in the back of the Truck near the pier warehouse (broom and motor are in the back, truck has train wheels on it)
- 2 Green Crates near the broken pier, close to a tipped over storage tower tank (close to previous location)

- The obstacle course that leads to the Cannery Pier was created by the technician that wrote the [Communication Report](./Communication%20Report.md) and [The Technician's Notebook](./The%20Technician%27s%20Notebook.md).

- The obstacle course can be skipped entirely by placing a deployed [Travois](./Travois.md) with an item inside on the lowest pier at the Cannery Pier, then placing the handles near the edge. Walking on the ocean below will then give the player the option to pick up the Travois, wherein the player will teleport up to the pier.

**Light Up The Night** was a side mission of the Predux [Episode 1: Do Not Go Gentle](./Episode%201%20-%20Do%20Not%20Go%20Gentle.md) of the [Wintermute](./Wintermute.md) story. It has since been replaced after the V1.47 Wintermute Redux version of the game, but is still playable to those that download versions V1.15, V1.30, or V1.37 of Steam version of _[The Long Dark](./The%20Long%20Dark.md)_ by using the [Time Capsule](./Time%20Capsule.md).
> “**Grey Mother Trusts you enough to tell you about a Distress Pistol stashed away by one of her neighbours. If you can find it, it would make a useful Wolf deterrent.**”

To start the mission, Mackenzie has to raise the Trust of [Grey Mother](./Grey%20Mother.md) to at least 175 points and speak to her about arming yourself. She will direct you to a nearby house in Milton, where her neighbor, whom used to work in the Coast Guard, has stashed a [Distress Pistol](./Distress%20Pistol.md) somewhere in his home where the neighbor children could not find it.

Make your way down the road to the [Paradise Meadows Farm](./Paradise%20Meadows%20Farm.md) and the house on the left is your objective (can easily be seen on the map). Go inside and go to the dressers next to the bathroom. The rug on the floor holds a hidden cache.
Grey Mother: "You'd leave an old lady defenseless so you could protect yourself? Shame on you, Mackenzie."
Mackenzie: "Of course not! But it would be nice to have a little more protection out there. Surely someone else in this town must have owned a gun of some kind."
Grey Mother: "Old Henry McDermott used to be with the Coast Guard. He kept a Distress Pistol around just in case."
Grey Mother: "Right. Henry was always worried about kids getting their hands on it, so it won't be easy to find."
_Walking to the house on the road to [Paradise Meadows Farm](./Paradise%20Meadows%20Farm.md), Mackenzie steps inside_

violations.message: Emphasis used instead of a heading
violations.context: _Mackenzie searches the house, eventually finding a carpet near the clothing dressers and searches a Hidden Cache, finding the flaregun_
_Mackenzie searches the house, eventually finding a carpet near the clothing dressers and searches a Hidden Cache, finding the flaregun_

While this side mission was ultimately cut from the game following the Redux update, Henry McDermott's name can be seen in a [Buffer Memory](./Buffer%20Memories.md) email at the [Orca Gas Station](./Orca%20Gas%20Station.md), suggesting that he was still canonically a resident of Milton before the First Flare (though renamed Hank McDermott).

Has an interior **Lighthouse** is a location in [Port Remnant](./Port%20Remnant.md). It is located next to the [Lighthouse Keeper's Cabin](./Lighthouse%20Keeper%27s%20Cabin.md), and is the first location visited when entering [Cauldron Island](./Cauldron%20Island.md).

A cave system is located below it, and is the location where the [Fulmar Autopilot Boat](./Fulmar%20Autopilot%20Boat.md) parks itself after leaving [Great Bear Island](./Great%20Bear%20Island.md). A makeshift shelter is located near the docks, with a [Bed](./Bed.md), [Trunk](./Trunk.md), and some tools are found inside (including 2 [Whale Oil Cans](./Whale%20Oil%20Can.md)), but the area is quite cold. A small cave past the docks gives way to a set of naturally cut stairs, leadi, revealing the inside of a ruined Lighthouse above.

[Wax Cylinder 2](./Wax%20Cylinder%202.md) and [Map (Church)](./Map%20%28Church%29.md) are located in a window sill when reaching the base floor of the Lighthouse. Wax Cylinder 2 is required to be picked up, as a key is tied with it to unlock the door to the outside region (the key cannot be picked up by itself).

The Lighthouse is quite old when viewed from the outside, and is falling apart. Unlike the [Fallen Lighthouse](./Fallen%20Lighthouse.md) in [Bleak Inlet](./Bleak%20Inlet.md), this one still stands (however the light itself has fallen, destroying the stairs inside in the process). The outside is weathered and boarded up, yet a small [Lighthouse Keeper's Cabin](./Lighthouse%20Keeper%27s%20Cabin.md) still stands in pristine condition next to it (and is much warmer than the docks).

**Lights in the Sky** is a [Wintermute](./Wintermute.md) [achievement](./The%20Long%20Dark%20%E2%80%94%20Achievements.md) in [Episode 2: Luminance Fugue](./Episode%202%20-%20Luminance%20Fugue.md) of _[The Long Dark](./The%20Long%20Dark.md)_.

This is an unmissable story achievement achieved during the mission [The Best Defense](./The%20Best%20Defense.md) after the encounter with the [Old Bear](./Old%20Bear.md). Simply make your way to the [Maintenance Yard](./Maintenance%20Yard.md) and fall asleep inside the Maintenance Shed for the night or continue onwards to the [Hunting Lodge](./Hunting%20Lodge.md) and after the night ends, the achievement will unlock.
The achievement's name is a reference to a quote from [Methuselah](./Methuselah.md): "The lights in the sky are a reckoning. The wonder of humanity and all its creations, laid bare."
**Spoiler Warning:****This page may contain spoilers from the [story](./Wintermute.md) of The Long Dark.**

**Lilith "Lily" Barker** (1969 – 1985) was the daughter of [Grey Mother](./Grey%20Mother.md) and [Martin Barker](./Martin%20Barker.md). She lived in the town of [Milton](./Milton.md) in the [Mountain Town](./Mountain%20Town.md) region and was determined to climb all the peaks of [Great Bear](./Great%20Bear%20Island.md) From a young age. One particular day at age 16 she wanted to climb the rock climbing portion of [Milton Park](./Milton%20Park.md); Grey Mother told her not to do so, but her father let her go. Lily fell during the climb and died, with the rock climbing portion of the park being shut down and a [Park Warning Notice](./Park%20Warning%20Notice.md) placed to warn others. The incident caused the permanent separation of Grey Mother and Martin Barker, with Martin keeping Lily's pearl necklace to remember his daughter and keeping it locked in the local bank.

Lily is buried in the graveyard across the street from [St. Christopher's Church](./St.%20Christopher%27s%20Church.md). In [Episode 1](./Episode%201%20-%20Do%20Not%20Go%20Gentle.md) of the story mode, When [Will Mackenzie](./Will%20Mackenzie.md) initally meets Grey Mother, her conversations constantly fluctuate between talking about [Astrid Greenwood](./Astrid%20Greenwood.md) and mentioning her own daughter. A confused Mackenzie is eventually tasked with finding a lockbox containing her daughter's pearls (unbeknownst to him) as this will help him find Astrid.

After retrieving the pearls, Mackenzie is asked to go "meet" Lily, finally learning the truth of the woman Grey Mother was occasionally refering to. He places them on Lily's grave and returns to Grey Mother, finally giving her closure after many years of suffering. Grey Mother then offers Lily's climbing equipment as a reward to Mackenzie, hoping that he can find Astrid before she suffers the same fate as her Lily, allowing Mackenzie a way to leave the town of Milton.
Her grave is located across from [St. Christopher's Church](./St.%20Christopher%27s%20Church.md) in the [Graveyard](./Graveyard.md), with the headstone reading 1969-1985 "Our Fallen Angel"

A [Recipe Card](./Recipe%20Cards.md) named after Lily can be found in the [Milton House (Grey Mother's)](./Milton%20House%20%28Grey%20Mother%27s%29.md) in [Survival Mode](./Survival%20Mode.md) called [Lily's Pancakes](./Lily%27s%20Pancakes.md). The recipe mentions her love of climbing, and implies that Pancakes with Peaches were her favorite food. Sometimes the Recipe Card is found behind the photo of her above the fireplace.

_A portrait found in [Milton House (Grey Mother's)](./Milton%20House%20%28Grey%20Mother%27s%29.md), likely of [Martin Barker](./Martin%20Barker.md), **Lilith Barker** and [Grey Mother](./Grey%20Mother.md)._

**Lily's Map** is a [collectible](./Collectibles.md) item obtained during [Chapter Four - Paradise Lost](./Paradise%20Lost.md).

Lily's map is found in the locked blue [Trunk](./Trunk.md) upstairs in Lily's room in [Milton House (Grey Mother's)](./Milton%20House%20%28Grey%20Mother%27s%29.md). The trunk can only be only be opened with [Lily's Trunk Key](./Lily%27s%20Trunk%20Key.md), which is received as a reward from the [Grey Mother](./Grey%20Mother.md) after completing [Chapter Three - The Grey Mother](./The%20Grey%20Mother.md).
The map outlines the route that the player can take to leave [Milton](./Milton.md) to reach [Mystery Lake (region)](./Mystery%20Lake%20%28region%29.md).

**Spoiler Warning:****This page may contain spoilers from the [story](./Wintermute.md) of The Long Dark.**
**Lily's Pancakes** is a food item in _The Long Dark._ It is learned from a unique [Recipe Card](./Recipe%20Cards.md) and is made with a [Cooking Skillet](./Cooking%20Skillet.md).

Lily's Pancakes are a relatively simple and efficient unique recipe with good calorie density and a positive (if small) [Condition](./Condition.md) restoring effect, comparable to [Camber Flight Porridge](./Camber%20Flight%20Porridge.md), but it uses [Acorn Grounds](./Acorn%20Grounds.md) instead of [Running River Oats](./Running%20River%20Oats.md). [Acorns](./Acorns.md) can be found abundantly on [Great Bear Island](./Great%20Bear%20Island.md), but require a [Heavy Hammer](./Heavy%20Hammer.md) to process. [Cooking Oil](./Cooking%20Oil.md) and [Maple Syrup](./Maple%20Syrup.md) are rarer (outside of acquiring them from the [Trader](./Trader.md)), but are used in small amounts, making [Pinnacle Peaches](./Pinnacle%20Peaches.md) the main limiting ingredient for Lily's Pancakes.

Acquiring the recipe card for Lily's Pancakes requires multiple rope climbs from [Forlorn Muskeg](./Forlorn%20Muskeg.md) or [Mystery Lake](./Mystery%20Lake%20%28region%29.md) and braving the [wolf](./Wolf.md)-infested town of Milton. The card can be found in the [Milton House (Grey Mother's)](./Milton%20House%20%28Grey%20Mother%27s%29.md) in [Mountain Town](./Mountain%20Town.md).

Little Island is located to the east of [Lonely Lighthouse](./Lonely%20Lighthouse.md), and south of [Hibernia Processing](./Hibernia%20Processing.md) and [The Riken](./The%20Riken.md).
[Old Man's Beard Lichen](./Old%20Man%27s%20Beard%20Lichen.md) and [Reishi Mushroom](./Reishi%20Mushroom.md) may be found on the island, along with [Rabbits](./Rabbit.md).
Also, every few days a couple of [Deer](./Deer.md) will be seen on the island and a [Deer Carcass](./Deer%20Carcass.md) can spawn. A frozen corpse can spawn on the side nearest the water.

**Description:** Survived 25 consecutive full days only consuming calories harvested from wild plants and animals (single game)
**Living Off the Land** is an [achievement](./The%20Long%20Dark%20%E2%80%94%20Achievements.md) in _[The Long Dark](./The%20Long%20Dark.md)_.

This achievement is obtained after surviving for twenty-five consecutive days by only consuming calories obtained from animals or plants harvested by the player in a single [Survival Mode](./Survival%20Mode.md) game. It is most easily done on Pilgrim.

Unlike [Silent Hunter](./Silent%20Hunter.md) or [Pacifist](./Pacifist.md), Living Off the Land can be obtained at any point during a single Survival mode play through. Note however that it is consecutive not cumulative. Eating the wrong food or drink will reset the twenty-five day counter.

Eating or drinking processed foods or drinks such as [Peanut Butter](./Peanut%20Butter.md) or [Orange Soda](./Orange%20Soda.md) will reset the counter. Eating raw or cooked meat **found inside buildings or otherwise** will reset the counter,[^1] which includes any assortment of fish or plants that spawn via [beachcombing](./Beachcombing.md).
Drinking [Cup of Herbal Tea](./Cup%20of%20Herbal%20Tea.md) or [Cup of Coffee](./Cup%20of%20Coffee.md) will also reset the counter.
In addition, consuming [Antibiotics](./Antibiotics.md) or [Painkillers](./Painkillers.md) will also reset the counter progress.
- [All] Fixed Living Off the Land achievement progress being reset when drinking tea crafted from Reishi Mushrooms or Rosehips.
- Fixed issue where creating Reishi and Rosehip tea invalidated the Living Off The Land achievement.
